A second enabled account whose settings.json lacks these entries runs
COMPLETELY UNGUARDED — which is the whole reason install-hooks.sh reads the
account list out of claude_accounts rather than assuming /root/.claude.
Order inside a matcher is significant only in that BOTH hooks run and the
first non-zero exit wins; guard-service-restart.py is listed first because
it is the older, narrower, purely-local guard and answers without any HTTP
The command paths are the LIVE /opt/ai-os/scripts/<name> symlinks that
install-symlinks.sh points back into this repo. Do not rewrite them to a
worktree path: a worktree is deleted when its project finishes and the
hook would then silently vanish from every turn on the box.
